description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instant and sorcery spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mind Games by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Gilded Lotus.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate the Gilded Lotus token by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Mind Games from your graveyard with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Gilded Lotus.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Gilded Lotus and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Activate the Gilded Lotus token by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other applicable permanent.
